title: Solutions to 6 problems in recurrence and Van der Corput sets
summary: We present solutions to six problems concerning sets of nice recurrence and van der Corput (vdC) sets. We answer a question of Moreira, repeated by Fish and Skinner, by showing that every set of ergodic nice recurrence is a set of nice recurrence. We answer questions of Bergelson as well as Bergelson and Lesigne by showing that every set of nice recurrence is a nice vdC-set, that the family of nice vdC-sets is partition regular, and that the family of sets of nice recurrence is partition regular. We mention that Chapman independently proved that sets of nice recurrence are partition regular.…
